spec.name: Furniture Fireplace
spec.description: A cozy brick fireplace with a broad dark-oak mantel, stepped stone footings, a recessed soot-dark firebox, and warmly glowing embers nestled around charred logs. Front faces negative Z; all geometry stays within the requested margins.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: cozy brick fireplace with dark mantel and warm stylized ember hearth. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
